name: The Fate of Zephras

angles.text: The quest marks a turning point for the Skyborne of Zephras Isle, weighing the loss of protective wards and the threat of Al'Akir against their new mission beyond their floating home.
Shamans recognize the grave threat posed by the Windlord Al'Akir, whose elemental dominion directly surrounds Zephras once ancient wards fall.

aliases: what is the fate of zephras
what happens in the fate of zephras
faq.answer: The Fate of Zephras is a pivotal quest following the defeat of Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir. With the protective wards masking Zephras Isle shattered, the player carries word of the looming elemental threat and Ayessa's proposed expedition to Azeroth directly to High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
faq.q: What is the quest The Fate of Zephras about?

faq.answer: Zephras Isle exists within the elemental domain of the Windlord Al'Akir. Ancient protective wards previously cloaked the sanctuary from his sight, but with those defenses fallen, the island stands exposed and vulnerable should the elemental lord direct his wrath toward it.
faq.q: Why is Zephras Isle in danger from Al'Akir?

faq.answer: Talaanis Shadowsong is the High Elder of the Skyborne community on Zephras Isle, stationed in the settlement of Valanaar. He oversees the governance and survival of his people, receiving reports regarding elemental threats and crucial decisions facing their home.

Ayessa is a key figure on Zephras Isle who formulates an expedition to Azeroth. Recognizing that the island cannot withstand an assault by Al'Akir without defense, she seeks solutions and allies outside their domain to ensure their people's long-term survival.

Lorthuna was the leader of the cult operating on Zephras Isle. Prior to this quest, she was slain above the Shrine of Akir, breaking her organization's leadership even as the conflict brought down the magical wards shielding the isle.
faq.q: Who was Lorthuna and what happened to her?

faq.answer: Muln is an advisor or scholar knowledgeable about the elemental lords who cautioned the defenders of Zephras about the immense power and peril of Al'Akir, confirming their vulnerability without magical concealment.

sections.body: The Fate of Zephras marks a critical reckoning for the inhabitants of Zephras Isle. Following the climactic confrontation above the Shrine of Akir, the cult leader Lorthuna has been eliminated, yet the victory comes at a severe price. The ancient wards that cloaked the island from Al'Akir's gaze have collapsed, leaving the floating sanctuary defenseless in the heart of the Windlord's domain. In response, a messenger is dispatched across the isle to bring word to Valanaar.
sections.title: A Precarious Victory

sections.body: The quest requires speaking directly with High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. The elder is informed not only of Lorthuna's demise and the broken wards, but also of Ayessa's bold determination to lead an expedition to Azeroth. With their magical veil lost, the islanders resolve to venture outward to find the means to safeguard their home. Shadowsong contemplates the balance of dread and triumph, noting that while Al'Akir is a terrifying menace, elemental gods operate on vast timescales that may grant them precious time to act.
sections.title: The Word to Valanaar

summary: The Fate of Zephras is a pivotal quest following the defeat of the cult leader Lorthuna on Zephras Isle. With the island's protective cloaking wards fallen, the player carries word of the looming elemental threat of Al'Akir and Ayessa's proposed mission to Azeroth to High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.
